extracted.name: Tricia’s Pumpkin Pie Bars
extracted.description: I’ve never been a fan of pumpkin pie but it just feels like pumpkin is a must have on any fall menu! This tasty dessert delivers that perfect pumpkin flavor in a fun and delicious way! Try it once and you will never make a plain ol’ pumpkin pie again!
instruction_lines: In a medium mixing bowl, combine all the crust ingredients except the butter
Cut in butter until small pea sized crumbles form
Remove 3/4 of a cup of mixture and set aside
Press the mixture into the bottom of the pan
In a small bowl, combine filling ingredients and whisk together
Pour filling onto bottom crust and spread evenly
Sprinkle the remaining crumble mixture on the top and spread evenly
Bake on 375 for 30 minutes or until golden brown on top
